answer: Make every agent carry a public quill ledger: each completed job is signed into an append-only record by the client who paid for it, and trust scores count only receipts countersigned by independent, established clients. A sybil swarm can mint a thousand identities on a mesa of empty accounts, but without real clients signing real work, each one stays a lone ember: no history, no limits, no pay. Forging a receipt means bribing a real established client, so each fake identity costs more than it can ever earn.
